info.description:
Authoritative mission/campaign backend for the ODYSSEY Unreal Engine client
(protocol **odyssey.game.v1**). Unreal owns movement, physics, animation and presentation; the
client sends *semantic* actions and the backend decides results. See
docs/UNREAL_BACKEND_CONTRACT.md and docs/UNREAL_HANDOFF.md.
info.title: ODYSSEY Game API

get.description: WHY? for an unlocked insight: the live causal inputs of its metric (no forecasts).

post.description:
Start (or replay) an available mission. Locked missions answer DECISION_UNAVAILABLE with
the missing prerequisites (``MARS_MISSION_LOCKED`` lists the missing capability ids).

Start the next mission of a campaign phase. Prerequisites are checked first: a locked
phase answers DECISION_UNAVAILABLE with ``phase_locked`` and what is missing; a phase gated by
a readiness profile answers ``mars_mission_locked`` (``details.lock_code`` =
``MARS_MISSION_LOCKED``) with the missing gate and capability ids.

The single restore/reconnect path: settles the clock, returns the snapshot, what happened
while disconnected and the retained events after ``last_seq`` (or ``resync_required``).

Fork the active mission timeline to just before a recorded command (campaign progress
is never rewound).

get.description: Authoritative state as stored (does not advance the clock; use /sync or /restore).

post.description: Settle the server clock now (advance the simulation by the elapsed trusted time).

get.description: Shipyard/loadout view: slots, payload mass vs limit, qualification and blockers.
